mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_tbl ( userId, password, name, nickName, gender, birthday, phone, address, profile, manner, introduction, points, isPrivate ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{nickName}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{profile}, #{manner}, #{introduction}, #{points}, #{isPrivate} )
mapper.select: SELECT tag FROM preferencetag_tbl WHERE userId = #{userId};
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM preferencetag_tbl where userId = #{userId} and tag = #{tag};
mapper.update: UPDATE user_tbl SET password = #{password} where userId = #{userId};
